summary: acer aspire 7 gaming laptop has random BSOD with error messages including KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED, ATTEMPTED_EXECUTE_OF_NONEXECUTE_MEMORY, IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL, Kernel Security Check Failure, and System Service Exception. The issue is exacerbated by the installation of Valorant and NVIDIA drivers.
detected_fault: Random BSOD caused by incompatible software (Valorant) and outdated drivers, possibly due to overheating issues.
suggested_solution: Perform a full clean of the laptop, including internal dust removal, fan cleaning, and reapplying thermal paste. Then, perform a clean install of Windows 11 with drivers and MS Office.
